text.tspan: Exact projection / allowed transforms / recipient / stream obligations
Quint models route, retry, queue, partial-write and recovery interleavings. Lean preserves exact binding, unique start and bounded prefix authority.
A route update, library retry, reconnect or cancellation never creates a new send right. Closure requires retirement of every delegated emitter.
